disclaimer: These are leads, not guaranteed placements. Tunisian directory coverage is thin and often outdated, so each entry says whether the site answered when checked on 2026-11-05. Nothing here is a purchase: do not pay for link packages.

strategy.title: Where the effort should go
points: Put real link-building effort into two sites: galylio.com (a real company, already the strongest at DR 16) and points.tn (a news outlet). Journalists, partners and directories link to companies and newsrooms, not to template blogs.

The 10 satellite blogs share the same description and the same kind of content. Almost nobody will link to them, and a network of look-alike sites can be treated as low value by Google. Keep publishing there, but do not spend outreach on them and do not mass-link them to each other or to the flagships.
The easiest links come first: partners, clients and suppliers who already know you (a 'Nos partenaires' mention costs them one line). Then media. Directories come last because they add little.
Expect slow results: one editorial link from a real Tunisian outlet moves DR more than dozens of directory entries.

groups.title: 1. Brand profiles (free, this week)
groups.intro: These do not add much DR, but they prove the brand is real to Google and AI answers, and they are required before anyone writes about you.

items.name: Google Business Profile — Galylio
items.note: Create or claim it with the exact company name, website and a French description (see the profile kit below). Verify ownership with the code Google sends.

items.name: Bing Places — Galylio
items.note: Can import the Google profile in a few clicks.

items.name: Galylio social profiles: add the website link and the same description
items.note: LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and X profiles already exist on the site. Check each one links to galylio.com and uses the same name and description.

items.name: Crunchbase — Galylio
items.note: Free company profile. Only add facts you can prove (what it does, location, website).

items.name: LinkedIn and Facebook pages — Points.tn
items.note: Create one page for the news site and post the best article of the day. Link to https://points.tn in the profile.

items.name: Google Publisher Center — add Points.tn
items.note: Free. Lets Google know your site is a news publication and its sections. The new About page already gives the transparency Google looks for.

items.name: Submit the Points.tn RSS feed to Feedly and similar readers
items.note: Feeds are live at https://points.tn/fr/feed.xml and https://points.tn/en/feed.xml. Readers are a free source of referral visits.

groups.title: 2. Partners, clients and suppliers (easiest real links)
groups.intro: People who already work with you have a reason to link. Send the short message from the outreach templates below.

items.name: Clients and partners of Galylio
items.note: List every company that has worked with Galylio. Ask each for a mention on their 'partners', 'references' or case-study page, linking to galylio.com. Offer to write the paragraph for them.

items.name: go2code training partners (universities, schools, employers)
items.note: Training centres usually list partner companies and employers. Ask for a partner-page link, and offer a guest talk or a short guide in return.

items.name: Business chambers and associations you belong to
items.note: Many chambers and professional associations publish a member directory with a website link. Check whether Galylio is a member or can become one. Membership terms and fees vary, so confirm before paying.

items.name: Reclaim mentions that do not link
items.note: Search Google for "Galylio" and "Points.tn" in quotes. When a site names you without a link, send the 'mention without link' template: it is the most successful outreach there is.

groups.title: 3. Media to pitch (answered on 2026-11-05)
groups.intro: A link inside a real article is worth far more than directory links. Pitch a short idea first, not a finished article. Contribution rules were not found for most of these: write to their editorial contact.

items.name: Managers.tn
items.note: Business and startup media for company leaders. Good fit for an 'AI for Tunisian companies' angle.

items.name: WeAreTech Africa
items.note: Publishes profiles of Tunisian tech founders and startups. Pitch a founder story or product launch.

items.name: Noqta
items.note: Publishes guides on the Tunisian tech ecosystem. A practical guide or expert quote could earn a mention.

items.name: Leaders
items.note: Tunisian business media. Pitch commentary on AI adoption in Tunisian companies.

items.name: Ilboursa
items.note: Its founder has spoken about helping entrepreneurs get visibility. Suited to company news.

items.name: L'Économiste Maghrébin — Tribunes
items.note: Publishes opinion pieces from outside authors on economy and technology.

items.name: Capmad
items.note: Said to accept guest articles. It refused our automated check (HTTP 403), so open it in a normal browser first.

items.name: Kapitalis, Business News, Tunisie Numérique, La Presse
items.note: National outlets. Do not ask them for links to Points.tn; instead become a useful source: send a data point or expert comment for a story they are already covering, and ask to be credited with a link.

groups.title: 4. Directories (low value, check first)
groups.intro: Most Tunisian directories are old. Three well-known ones did not answer at all from our server on 2026-11-05.

items.name: Pages Maghreb
items.note: Answered. Launched around 2011 with free registration; check the listing is still free and the website link is shown.

items.name: Destinali (pan-African directory)
items.note: Answered. Says it has a free listing tier. The article that recommends it is promotional, so judge it yourself.

items.name: Clutch, GoodFirms, Sortlist (service-company directories)
items.note: Reputable for agencies and IT service companies. Profiles need real client reviews, so ask existing clients first.

items.name: Pages Jaunes Tunisie, Tunisie Business Directory, TN-Blogs
items.note: pagesjaunes.com.tn, tunisie-business.net and tn-blogs.com did not answer on 2026-11-05. Skip unless you confirm in a browser that they are still active.

groups.title: 5. Content that earns links
groups.intro: Give people a reason to link. Without this, outreach rarely works.

items.name: Galylio client case study
items.note: A real before/after with numbers from one client (with their approval). Case studies are what trade media and partners quote.

items.name: 'AI and automation for Tunisian small businesses' guide
items.note: A practical, French-language guide with Tunisian examples and prices. Business groups and training centres link to such guides.

items.name: Original data from your own projects
items.note: 1111.tn price comparisons can become a short study (how prices of a product category moved over a year). Data is the easiest thing to get cited.

outreach.title: Pitch to a media outlet
outreach.when: Use for the media in section 3. Send to the editorial contact, one outlet at a time, and adapt the angle.
outreach.subject: Proposition de sujet : [ANGLE EN UNE PHRASE]
outreach.body:
Bonjour [PRÉNOM],

Je suis [VOTRE NOM] de Galylio, une entreprise tunisienne spécialisée en intelligence artificielle et automatisation.

Je vous propose un sujet pour [NOM DU MÉDIA] : [ANGLE : par exemple « comment les PME tunisiennes utilisent déjà l'IA, avec trois exemples chiffrés »].

Je peux vous fournir [UNE DONNÉE, UN CAS CLIENT OU UN AVIS D'EXPERT], et rédiger un texte de [800] mots si le sujet vous intéresse.

Seriez-vous ouvert à en discuter ?

Cordialement,
[VOTRE NOM] — [FONCTION], Galylio
https://galylio.com

outreach.title: Partner, client or supplier: ask for a mention
outreach.when: Use for section 2. Offer to write the paragraph yourself so it costs them nothing.
outreach.subject: Une petite mention de notre collaboration ?
outreach.body:
Bonjour [PRÉNOM],

Merci pour notre collaboration sur [PROJET]. Nous préparons notre page références et nous aimerions y citer [VOTRE ENTREPRISE].

Si vous avez une page « partenaires » ou « références », seriez-vous d'accord pour y ajouter une ligne avec un lien vers https://galylio.com ? Voici un texte prêt à copier :

« Galylio — solutions d'intelligence artificielle et d'automatisation en Tunisie. »

Je peux aussi le publier de notre côté pour vous : dites-moi ce qui vous arrange.

Merci d'avance,
[VOTRE NOM]

outreach.title: Someone named you without a link
outreach.when: Use for any page that mentions Galylio or Points.tn without linking. Replies are common because the request is tiny.
outreach.subject: Votre article sur [SUJET] : un lien vers la source ?
outreach.body:
Bonjour [PRÉNOM],

Merci d'avoir cité [Galylio / Points.tn] dans votre article « [TITRE] » ([URL DE L'ARTICLE]).

Pourriez-vous ajouter un lien vers [https://galylio.com / https://points.tn] sur le nom ? Cela permet à vos lecteurs de retrouver facilement le site.

Merci beaucoup,
[VOTRE NOM]

avoid: Paid link packages, 'DR 50 backlinks for $20' offers and private blog networks: they are link spam and can lead to penalties.
Mass submission of the same site to hundreds of directories: low value and a spam signal.
Linking the satellite blogs to each other or to the flagship sites in bulk: keep cross-links editorial and relevant.
Exchanging links on a large scale ('link for link') or asking outlets to link to a site they have not written about.
Putting claims in profiles or pitches that you cannot prove (awards, client names, figures).
